what_is_counted: research contracts, declared universes, and open acquisition gaps only
what_is_not_counted: observed evidence, completed searches, verified incidents, promoted claims, actor hops, risk scores, origin findings, or conclusions

gaps.description: No independent biosafety, biosecurity, public-health, privacy, and security review of the selection boundary.
No case has a frozen jurisdiction, date window, and source-complete or matched comparator denominator.
No public receipt packet has passed security review and ordinary Clifford promotion gates.
No calibrated model joins containment, evidence, recovery, and recurrence margins under finite portfolio capacity.
Security-sensitive operational details, patient records, facility vulnerabilities, and pathogen-design information remain inadmissible to the public estate.

copy_ready_caveat: This programme records bounded research instructions and control questions, not verified findings. A laboratory, grant, publication, provider relationship, committee role, policy, capability statement, missing record, incident report, or shared surface does not establish origin, misuse, intent, coordination, influence, causation, negligence, illegality, wrongdoing, or absence. Follow every eventual claim to its source, evidence class, time window, security treatment, selection rule, and independent review status.
